AbsolutePathBuf.description:
A path that is guaranteed to be absolute and normalized (though it is not guaranteed to be canonicalized or exist on the filesystem).

IMPORTANT: When deserializing an `AbsolutePathBuf`, a base path must be set using [AbsolutePathBufGuard::new]. If no base path is set, the deserialization will fail unless the path being deserialized is already absolute.

CodexErrorInfo.description:
This translation layer make sure that we expose codex error code in camel case.

When an upstream HTTP status is available (for example, from the Responses API or a provider), it is forwarded in `httpStatusCode` on the relevant `codexErrorInfo` variant.

oneOf.description: Failed to connect to the response SSE stream.
oneOf.title: ResponseStreamConnectionFailedCodexErrorInfo

oneOf.description: The response SSE stream disconnected in the middle of a turn before completion.
oneOf.title: ResponseStreamDisconnectedCodexErrorInfo

oneOf.description: Reached the retry limit for responses.
oneOf.title: ResponseTooManyFailedAttemptsCodexErrorInfo

oneOf.description: Returned when `turn/start` or `turn/steer` is submitted while the current active turn cannot accept same-turn steering, for example `/review` or manual `/compact`.
oneOf.title: ActiveTurnNotSteerableCodexErrorInfo

MessagePhase.description:
Classifies an assistant message as interim commentary or final answer text.

Providers do not emit this consistently, so callers must treat `None` as "phase unknown" and keep compatibility behavior for legacy models.

oneOf.description:
Mid-turn assistant text (for example preamble/progress narration).

Additional tool calls or assistant output may follow before turn completion.
The assistant's terminal answer text for the current turn.

ReasoningEffort.description: A non-empty reasoning effort value advertised by the model.

ReasoningPolicyPhase.description: Response event from the agent NOTE: Make sure none of these values have optional types, as it will mess up the extension code-gen. The exact request policy used for one model stream attempt. This is protocol state so rollout reconstruction and late-attaching clients observe the same decision as live consumers.

SurfacedToolResult.description: Authoritative typed tool result surfaced as the terminal result of a turn. `canonical_message`, when present, is owner-authored and may be copied unchanged into legacy last-message consumers. `value` is never rendered into synthetic assistant prose by the host.

byteRange.description: Byte range in the parent `text` buffer that this element occupies.

placeholder.description: Optional human-readable placeholder for the element, displayed in the UI.

agentNickname.description: Optional random unique nickname assigned to an AgentControl-spawned sub-agent.

agentRole.description: Optional role (agent_role) assigned to an AgentControl-spawned sub-agent.

cliVersion.description: Version of the CLI that created the thread.

createdAt.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) when the thread was created.

cwd.description: Working directory captured for the thread.

ephemeral.description: Whether the thread is ephemeral and should not be materialized on disk.

forkedFromId.description: Source thread id when this thread was created by forking another thread.

gitInfo.description: Optional Git metadata captured when the thread was created.

id.description: Identifier for this thread. Codex-generated thread IDs are UUIDv7.

modelProvider.description: Model provider used for this thread (for example, 'openai').

parentThreadId.description: The ID of the parent thread. This will only be set if this thread is a subagent.

path.description: [UNSTABLE] Path to the thread on disk.

preview.description: Usually the first user message in the thread, if available.

recencyAt.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) used for thread recency ordering.

sessionId.description: Session id shared by threads that belong to the same session tree.

source.description: Origin of the thread (CLI, VSCode, codex exec, codex app-server, etc.).

status.description: Current runtime status for the thread.

threadSource.description: Optional analytics source classification for this thread.

turns.description: Only populated on `thread/resume`, `thread/rollback`, `thread/fork`, and `thread/read` (when `includeTurns` is true) responses. For all other responses and notifications returning a Thread, the turns field will be an empty list.

updatedAt.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) when the thread was last updated.

ThreadExtra.description: Extra app-server data for a thread.

oneOf.description: EXPERIMENTAL - proposed plan item content. The completed plan item is authoritative and may not match the concatenation of `PlanDelta` text.
oneOf.title: PlanThreadItem

aggregatedOutput.description: The command's output, aggregated from stdout and stderr.

commandActions.description: A best-effort parsing of the command to understand the action(s) it will perform. This returns a list of CommandAction objects because a single shell command may be composed of many commands piped together.

durationMs.description: The duration of the command execution in milliseconds.

processId.description: Identifier for the underlying PTY process (when available).

durationMs.description: The duration of the MCP tool call in milliseconds.
The duration of the dynamic tool call in milliseconds.

agentsStates.description: Last known status of the target agents, when available.

id.description: Unique identifier for this collab tool call.

model.description: Model requested for the spawned agent, when applicable.

prompt.description: Prompt text sent as part of the collab tool call, when available.

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort requested for the spawned agent, when applicable.

receiverThreadIds.description: Thread ID of the receiving agent, when applicable. In case of spawn operation, this corresponds to the newly spawned agent.

senderThreadId.description: Thread ID of the agent issuing the collab request.

status.description: Current status of the collab tool call.

tool.description: Name of the collab tool that was invoked.

ToolLifecycleContext.description: Queue and waiter state captured at a lifecycle boundary.

ToolLifecycleTimerWait.description: Attribution for a bounded or sticky lifecycle wait.

completedAt.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) when the turn completed.

completion.description: Machine-derived completion proof persisted at the terminal turn boundary.

durationMs.description: Duration between turn start and completion in milliseconds, if known.

error.description: Only populated when the Turn's status is failed.

id.description: Identifier for this turn. Codex-generated turn IDs are UUIDv7.

items.description: Thread items currently included in this turn payload.

itemsView.description: Describes how much of `items` has been loaded for this turn.

startedAt.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) when the turn started.

surfacedResult.description: Authoritative typed tool result surfaced when the turn terminalized.

timing.description: Immutable wall-clock profile persisted at the terminal turn boundary.

oneOf.description: `items` was not loaded for this turn. The field is intentionally empty.
`items` contains only a display summary for this turn.
`items` contains every ThreadItem available from persisted app-server history for this turn.

TurnTiming.description:
Immutable wall-clock profile captured at the core terminal boundary.

`exclusive` is the canonical elapsed-time partition. Values in `unions` and `local` may overlap and must not be added to that partition.

deterministicContinuationReceipts.description: Bounded, aggregated host-managed continuation receipts. Resource identities are hashes; raw paths and payloads are never included.

machineDurationNs.description: Inclusive duration minus only the interactive-only wait partition.

modelRequests.description: Per-sampling-request milestones, ordered by request. Times are offsets from turn start and are diagnostic only; they are not additive buckets.

observationalNonprogressLatency.description: Latency observed on the same unchanged-state, unchanged-next-action generations as `observational_nonprogress_tokens`. Model-stream wait remains a model-side wall-clock measurement; `decision_latency_ns` narrows that to dispatch-to-first-actionable-output where observable.

observationalNonprogressTokens.description: Provider usage observed on generations where neither relevant structured state nor the next-correct-action changed. This is a diagnostic and is never treated as measured avoidable savings.

terminalization.description: Additive terminalization phase timings. Older records deserialize to zeroes; the terminalization receipt remains authoritative for phases that occur after live dispatch.

toolCalls.description: Bounded per-call relay timings captured at delivery. Offsets are from turn start; phase durations are diagnostics and are not additive with the canonical `exclusive` partition.

toolClosure.description: Exact accepted-call closure ledger. A terminal event is publishable only when every accepted direct and nested execution has timing, a terminal outcome, and exactly one persisted projection.

completionReviewReadyPhaseCount.description: Completion-review coordinators that observed the ready phase.

completionReviewTerminalPhaseCount.description: Completion-review coordinators that observed the terminal phase.

executedValidationDurationNs.description: Total wall-clock nanoseconds spent in validation commands that executed.

logicalGenerationCount.description: Logical workflow generations. `model_request_count` remains the authoritative physical provider-attempt aggregate.

ownerDrainedContinuationCount.description: Continuations drained and recorded by their code-mode owner.

purposeAggregates.description: Bounded to the stable purpose enum's cardinality.

readyStartupPrewarmCount.description: Ready startup prewarms observed by the first model request.

residualDeterministicGenerationCount.description: Residual deterministic generation requests proved by the reasoning governor, including requests elided before provider dispatch.

suppressedDeterministicContinuationCount.description: Authoritative number of model boundaries suppressed by accepted deterministic-continuation receipts. A receipt whose `suppressed_continuation_count` is N contributes N, not one. Invalid, rejected, and zero-count receipts contribute nothing. This counter is independent of `generations_by_disposition`.

suppressedValidationOutputCount.description: Validation tool outputs intentionally suppressed by admission policy.

decisionLatencyNs.description: Sum of dispatch-to-first-actionable-output latency for requests where an actionable output was observed.

toolActiveUnionNs.description: Sum of per-generation unioned tool-active durations. Parallel tools within one generation are not double-counted.

planningCompactionOverlapUnionNs.description: Time simultaneously attributed to planning and compaction.

planningExclusiveUnionNs.description: Planning union with nested compaction overlap removed.

planningUnionNs.description: Inclusive planning union, including any nested compaction.

firstDomainActionMs.description: Time from turn start until the first authorized domain-work handler is entered.

firstInfrastructureActionMs.description: Time from turn start until the first authorized control/plumbing tool handler is entered.

firstSuccessfulDomainActionMs.description: Time from turn start until the first domain-work tool completes successfully.

firstSuccessfulUsefulActionMs.description: Time from turn start until the first domain-work tool completes successfully.

firstToolAcceptedMs.description: Time from turn start until the first tool call is accepted for dispatch.

firstToolDiscoveryActionMs.description: Time from turn start until the first authorized tool-schema discovery handler is entered.

firstToolGateAdmittedMs.description: Time from turn start until the first tool call passes the parallel gate.

firstToolHandlerEntryMs.description: Time from turn start until the first authorized tool handler is entered.

firstUsefulActionMs.description: Time from turn start until the first authorized domain-work tool handler is entered.

firstUsefulToolAcceptedMs.description: Time from turn start until the first domain-work tool is accepted for dispatch.

firstUsefulToolGateAdmittedMs.description: Time from turn start until the first domain-work tool passes the parallel gate.

userInputRecordedMs.description: Time from turn start until the first user input begins durable recording.

decisionLatencyNs.description: Dispatch-to-first-actionable-output latency. This excludes reasoning deltas and partial tool arguments; missing actionable output stays null.

executorAdmittedToolCallCount.description: Direct model-issued calls that acquired the executor admission gate.

executorMaxConcurrentToolCalls.description: Peak direct model-issued calls holding executor admission concurrently.

generationIndex.description: Zero-based logical generation owning this physical provider attempt.

generationPurpose.description: Stable workflow purpose for the logical generation. Physical retries inherit this value from their owning generation.

modelEmittedToolCallCount.description: Tool calls parsed from completed model output before relay persistence or executor polling. Recorded on the generation's primary attempt.

modelStreamWaitNs.description: Directly observed model-stream wait for this physical attempt.

physicalAttemptIds.description: Physical provider attempts observed for this logical request, including retries and transport fallbacks.

relevantStateFingerprint.description: A redacted hash of only the structured state relevant to this request.

requestTokenCategories.description: Aggregate-only full logical prompt accounting. No prompt text, repository paths, tool arguments, or hashes are persisted here.

samplingRequestId.description: Stable identity shared by every physical provider attempt for this logical request.

tokenUsage.description: Provider-reported usage for this physical attempt. Missing usage stays null, including failed attempts for which the provider reported none.

toolActiveUnionNs.description: Unioned tool-active duration attributed to this generation. Parallel tool calls are counted once per wall-clock interval.

toolCallCount.description: Tool calls whose deferred executor future was polled for this generation. Kept under its historical field name for rollout compatibility.

localInputEstimate.description: One-pass local estimate over the complete serialized logical prompt.

localReconciliationResidual.description: `local_input_estimate - logical_total`. This exposes estimator and JSON envelope effects instead of silently assigning them to a category.

logicalTotal.description: Sum of the mutually exclusive category estimates above.

providerInputTokens.description: Provider-reported full input tokens, when usage was returned.

repeatedUnchangedContext.description: Overlapping diagnostic: logical tokens in categories whose exact hash matched the preceding request. This is not added to `logical_total`.

TurnTimingTokenCategoryBasis.description:
Semantic basis used by request token-category accounting.

Categories describe the complete logical prompt presented to the model. They do not describe only websocket deltas, newly allocated client memory, uncached provider input, or reconciliation residuals.

TurnTimingToolCall.description:
Relay and persistence lifecycle for one model-issued or nested tool call.

All `*_at_ms` values are monotonic offsets from turn start. A missing boundary means the call ended before that boundary was observed. No tool arguments, output, or paths are persisted; nested identifiers are opaque correlation keys only.

backgroundProcessExpected.description: A retained running process is expected only when the response returned a background process identifier for a later `write_stdin` call.

deliveredAtMs.description: Historical relay-completion boundary. This predates persistence timing and therefore does not prove that the output reached conversation history or the rollout recorder.

execCleanupStateObserved.description: The exec handler reached its post-cleanup process-store observation.

lifecycleEvents.description: Exact event-site lifecycle records. Older timestamp fields remain as compatibility projections of these boundaries.

modelResumedAtMs.description: The next model generation began after this result became model-visible.

outcome.description: Payload-free terminal classification reported by the tool runtime.

outputCollectedAtMs.description: The tool result has been collected into the host relay, before any post-handler evidence, projection, persistence, or delivery work.

outputModelVisibleAtMs.description: The direct tool output was committed to model-visible conversation history. Durable rollout persistence is tracked independently by the tool-closure ledger. Nested code-mode calls are represented by the outer direct tool output and leave this absent.

parentCallId.description: Model-visible outer tool call that owns this nested call, when any.

parentCellId.description: Runtime cell that issued this nested tool request, when any.

readyToSampleToDispatchNs.description: Monotonic latency from the host proving that sampling is unblocked to the provider request reaching its transport dispatch boundary.

runningProcessAfterCleanup.description: The process manager still retained this call after foreground cleanup.

runtimeToolCallId.description: Code-mode's payload-free per-cell invocation id, when any.

workspaceEvidenceBeforeCacheHit.description: Whether the pre-handler workspace identity came from the latest authoritative capture instead of running a fresh capture.

workspaceEvidenceBeforeTimedOutGitDepend.description: Git dependencies that crossed the bounded capture deadline during a fresh pre-handler workspace capture.

TurnTimingToolCallIdentity.description: Payload-free identity for one accepted tool execution in the terminal closure ledger.

TurnTimingToolClosure.description:
Reconciliation summary for all accepted tool executions in a turn.

`complete` is true for a turn with no accepted calls. Otherwise it requires every accepted execution to have a timing record, terminal outcome, and exactly-once persisted projection, with no orphan or duplicate lifecycle records and no ledger overflow.

TurnTimingToolLifecycleEvent.description: Exact event-site timestamp from the turn's single monotonic clock.

text_elements.description: UI-defined spans within `text` used to render or persist special elements.
